_readme: Shipped English texts of the app. Keep local wording in ../strings.local.json so release changes can arrive without mixing them with translations. Use only the keys you want changed plus "language" (e.g. "fr"); that file survives updates, and keys it does not name stay English. Update letters leave changed release files for the agent to decide. Check with: bun strings.ts --check

settings.voice.whisperNote: Free for about 200 minutes of speech a day (Cloudflare's daily Workers AI allowance). On Cloudflare's free plan it never costs anything: past the allowance it pauses until the next day and your browser's own recognition takes over. On the paid Workers plan, speech beyond that costs about $0.0005 per minute. The recording goes to Whisper in your own Cloudflare account and is not stored.
